description: An open source content management system.
summary: AI may be used, but contributors must fully understand, review and test all AI-generated code, ensure GPL compatibility, and label AI-assisted PRs with [AI]. Vibe-coded submissions are not allowed, and AI-generated explanations and comments must be reviewed; raw AI answers are discouraged.

evidence.quote: However, AI-generated code must never be submitted without full human understanding, review, and validation by the contributor.

Any pull request that contains AI-assisted or AI-generated content (code, tests, documentation, or substantial comments) must be clearly marked by adding [AI] at the beginning of the PR title and/or using the [AI Generated] label.
All contributions must be compatible with the GNU GPL version 2 or later.
The contributor is always accountable for the final submission.

AI-generated explanations, testing instructions, comments or documentation must also be reviewed.
